accounting_framework: IFRS is the sole GAAP (no local Bahraini GAAP; CCL Art 219). CBB: IFRS for conventional banks, AAOIFI FAS for Islamic banks.

default_tax_line.label: Taxes
default_tax_line.basis: No general corporate income tax as of mid-2026 (the 46% tax applies to hydrocarbon extraction only). A draft 10% CIT (thresholds: BHD 1m revenue / BHD 200k profit; 10% above BHD 200k taxable income) is targeted at 1 Jan 2027 but UNENACTED as of June 2026.

tax_recipes.cit_2027_watch: If the draft 10% CIT is enacted, forecast years from 2027 should carry tax_pct_ebt ~ 0.10 for in-scope companies - flag this in any forecast crossing 2027 and let the user choose.
tax_recipes.pillar_two: DMTT 15% (Decree-Law 11/2024, NBR-administered) for FYs from 1 Jan 2025, groups >= EUR 750m: use 0.15 if in scope.

vat_note: VAT 10% since 2022 (mandatory registration BHD 37,500). AR/AP balances may be VAT-inclusive. A 10% municipality tax applies to commercial property rentals and residential rentals to expatriates.
fiscal_year_note: Calendar year default. BHD pegged at 0.376/USD; amounts quoted to 3 decimals (fils).
depreciation_note: No codified tax-depreciation schedule (no general income tax); book depreciation per IFRS.
pillar_two_note: DMTT in force from FY2025 for large MNE groups.
disclosure: No general corporate income tax is modeled (0% default) per the law in force as of mid-2026; the hydrocarbon 46% regime, the 15% DMTT for large MNE groups, and the draft 10% CIT targeted for 2027 are outside the default - forecasts extending into 2027+ should consider the draft CIT. Not tax advice.
